extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and prospective article creators / editors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who attempt to create a new Wikipedia page (why the page may not exist and what steps to take to create or locate the content). Includes procedural requirements and troubleshooting tips.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must have an account and meet the autoconfirmed status before creating articles; if you don't meet this, use alternative submission routes (article wizard or request a new article).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft / request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot directly create the page (e.g., not autoconfirmed), prepare a draft via the article wizard or use the 'request a new article' process so others can review and create it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Cooke's repudiated Jimmy's World" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for alternative titles or spellings and search the encyclopedia before creating a new page to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to this title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect backlinks to determine if the subject is covered elsewhere or if a redirect would be appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation / database-update delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes for propagation or try the purge function to refresh; absence may be temporary rather than deletion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify alternate capitalizations and, when appropriate, add redirects rather than creating duplicate pages with different capitalization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the deletion log and the help page about deleted creations to understand deletion reasons and whether the content can be recreated or appealed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for subject in sister projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for Cooke's repudiated Jimmy's World on one of Wikipedia's sister projects: Wiktionary, Wikibooks, Wikiquote, Wikisource, Wikiversity, Commons, Wikivoyage, Wikinews, Wikidata, Wikispecies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The topic might be covered on a related Wikimedia project rather than the English Wikipedia; search those projects before creating a new article.
